# Utilities

- Breakpoints: sm 576px, md 768px, lg 992px, xl 1200px, xxl 1400px. Insert the breakpoint after the prefix: col-md-6, d-lg-flex, text-md-center.
- Spacing: 0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8 → 0, .25, .5, .75, 1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4rem (e.g. p-4 = 1rem, gap-3 = .75rem). Negative margins: m-n*, mt-n*, mb-n*, ms-n*, me-n*, mx-n* (1–8, per breakpoint). Auto margins: m-auto, mt-auto, mb-auto, ms-auto, me-auto, mx-auto, my-auto. s/e/x are logical (inline-start/-end), so they flip in dir="rtl".
- For glass to read, give the page a rich background (e.g. body class="bg-mesh-aurora"). Utilities win the cascade (no !important needed by you).
